messages:
maria: Heads-up — bringing up customer Mirage's LoRA blend on mistral-7b-q4. Quick smoke after merge shows tokenization mismatch on multi-turn prompts. Anyone seen this pattern?

josh: saw similar with earlier stitch merges. Can you paste failing prompt + model/logs? :eyes:

maria: paste...
```
User: Summarize the policy changes.
Assist: ...
```
Response truncated mid-sentence, and tokens look shifted (periods moved). logs:
```
[2026-02-12 09:11:22] kv_merge: applied lora alpha=0.6
[2026-02-12 09:11:22] tokenizer: length 42 -> 43 after merge
```

tara: likely tokenizer-vocab-id mapping drift after adapter merge. Did we use tokenizer from base or from finetune? :thinking:

maria: used finetune tokenizer (customer provided). But we merged LoRA onto Mistral base and then quantized to int4 with qmap=dynamic. Merge cmd:
```
merge_lora --base mistral-7b-v1 --lora mirage_v2 --alpha 0.6 --out mirage-merged.pt
quantize --model mirage-merged.pt --bits 4 --qmap dynamic
```

kevin: two hypothesis: (1) tokenizer unknown tokens remapped causing off-by-one tokenization; (2) KV cache alignment bug in our runtime when using merged weights + quant kernels. I can repro locally and run tiny eval pack.

maria: ran quick eval pack (20 prompts) — metrics: ROUGE-L down 6 pts vs baseline, hallucination rate up 4%. Attaching snippet of differences.

josh: please run this triage: 1) remerge using base tokenizer (ignore customer tokenizer) 2) run quantize with qmap=static 3) run inference w/ kv_cache_flush on initial step. If issue disappears we can pinpoint.

maria: starting remerge now. pinging @kevin to run runtime kernel trace when ready. Thanks.

eval-bot: quick-eval results uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/mirage/2129876543/quick-20.json :thumbsup:

kevin: I can reproduce KV misalignment on sequence continuation when quant kernels use 4-bit fused-gemm. Switching to fallback dequant path fixes. Filing issue IR-4402.

tara: good catch. For immediate customer: recommend rolling back to alpha=0.4 and qmap=static, run full 200-case eval. Also ask customer for original tokenizer mapping if they insist on their vocab.

maria: noted. I'll schedule full eval tomorrow and update ticket. Thanks team :shipit:
